candidate_evidence.quote: Participants will receive Descovy® 200/25mg 1 tablet once daily for 72 weeks.

coder_notes: Off-topic record: 'GBM' here means gay, bisexual and other men who have sex with men; HIV PrEP care-delivery trial (PHASE4). Not glioblastoma (not anti-GBM disease either). TAF/FTC fixed-dose combination split into two rows, given in both arms -> soc_backbone; no antitumour agent. Treatment setting not applicable to this population, coded unclear. The EXPERIMENTAL-labelled arm is the standard-of-care delivery model, hence control_arm_from_other_arms yes. Drug levels in dried blood spots/hair are adherence measures, not tumour PK.
